description: The chart illustrates the distribution of Pass@1 accuracy of Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct on MATH-500, divided into five bins. The horizontal axis represents Pass@1, labeled with values ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, and is divided into five categories: 0.0-0.2, 0.2-0.4, 0.4-0.6, 0.6-0.8, and 0.8-1.0. The vertical axis is labeled "Percentage" and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The bars are light blue in color, and their heights correspond to the percentage values: the first bar (0.0-0.2) is at 11.2%, the second and third bars (0.2-0.4 and 0.4-0.6) are both at 3.4%, the fourth bar (0.6-0.8) is at 5.8%, and the fifth bar (0.8-1.0) is at 76.2%. The bars are not sorted in any particular order other than by their bin ranges, and the last bar is significantly taller than the others. A red dashed line is annotated with "mean: 0.82" near the taller bars, indicating the mean value of the distribution.
